bugs.title: The navigation did not occur as expected, instead the page was reloaded.
bugs.observed: Clicking '← Home' changed the URL to /index.html and updated the title and page text.
bugs.expected: Clicking '← Home' should navigate to index.html without reloading the page.
bugs.discrepancy: The navigation did not occur as expected, instead the page was reloaded.

bugs.title: The application did not follow the BROWSER_BACK action, instead showing the starting page again.
bugs.observed: Navigating back from /pricing.html to /index.html.
bugs.expected: Going back should return to the previous page in the browser history.
bugs.discrepancy: The application did not follow the BROWSER_BACK action, instead showing the starting page again.

bugs.title: A required field accepted an invalid value without any observable change, which is unexpected behavior.
bugs.observed: Typing a long username caused no change to the page.
bugs.expected: The application should validate the input and either update the form or show validation errors.
bugs.discrepancy: A required field accepted an invalid value without any observable change, which is unexpected behavior.

bugs.title: A control that promises to save and redirect did not change the URL, suggesting it failed to execute properly.
bugs.observed: Clicking 'Save settings' produced a confirmation message but did not navigate to another page.
bugs.expected: Clicking 'Save settings' should save the form data and navigate to a success or confirmation page.
bugs.discrepancy: A control that promises to save and redirect did not change the URL, suggesting it failed to execute properly.

bugs.title: The sign-up options became unreachable after the resize, which is unexpected behavior.
bugs.evidence: NO LONGER reachable: Sign up -> signup.html; Create account -> signup.html
bugs.observed: Resizing to mobile hid a#nav-signup and a#cta-signup; the only links left are Widgets -> widgets.html; Settings -> settings.html; Pricing -> pricing.html.
bugs.expected: Mobile resizing should not make sign-up options unreachable, as they were still reachable before the resize.
bugs.discrepancy: The sign-up options became unreachable after the resize, which is unexpected behavior.

bugs.title: The back navigation did not update the page content, leaving it in an error state.

bugs.expected: Going back should restore the previous state of the application, including its content and title.
